Show the steps that produced a table

Source: R/c4e_meta.R
c4e_history.Rd

Every c4e step records its name and the arguments it used, after defaults were filled in from upstream, along with how long it took. c4e_history() returns that record, and printing it shows the pipeline as code. Data arguments, such as the raster or the survey, are not recorded and are left out of the code.

Usage

c4e_history(x)

Arguments

x

A c4e_tbl.

Value

A tibble of class c4e_history with one row per step: step, call (the step as code), elapsed (seconds) and time.

Examples

x <- update_meta(tibble::tibble(ID = "1"), key = "ID")
c4e_history(x)
#> <c4e history: no recorded steps>
